steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Metamorphosis myths involve humans or gods being transformed into animals, plants, stones or constellations | Key Fact: Ovid's Metamorphoses is the most important literary source — it collects around 250 transformation myths | Key Fact: Transformations served multiple purposes: punishment, protection, reward, escape and explanation | Key Fact: Daphne was transformed into a laurel tree to escape Apollo's pursuit — Apollo then adopted the laurel as his symbol
